The '''Filly huge man''', also called a '''scavenger''',<ref>Credited as such in "[[The Target]]"</ref> is a character in [[Filly]] {{In|FOTV}}. 

==Background==
He is a burly, aggressive man who lives in the town of [[Filly]] in the area of the former [[Los Angeles]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Target]]===
When [[Lucy MacLean]] enters the town of Filly, she walks by the huge man wielding a [[sledgehammer (TV series)|sledgehammer]], who glares at her threateningly. She soon watches as he grabs a [[Filly townsperson]] who was beating up another man, and he himself starts beating up the former aggressor.

===[[The Head]]===
The Filly huge man is one of a group of six [[Scavenger (TV series)|scavengers]] led by [[Tom (TV series)|Tom]] investigating [[Maximus]]' suit of [[T-60 power armor (TV series)|T-60 power armor]], which he left unguarded outside Filly. When Maximus tries to recover the armor, the huge man fights for it along with three other scavengers. After initially beating Maximus into the ground, the group loses interest in him.

The huge man is last seen when Maximus clobbers him across the jaw twice with a very large wrench, knocking him unconscious and possibly killing him.

The '''Filly townspeople''' are wastelanders at [[Filly]] {{In|FOTV}}. 

==Background==
These people are seen at the town of Filly near the [[Los Angeles|Boneyard]] in [[New California]]. They come from various groups and backgrounds; some are inhabitants of the town, while others are visitors from around the region. These people include local [[Filly vendor|vendors]], [[Scavenger (TV series)|scavengers]], and even raiders.

One known townsperson is the father of Sheriff [[Troy (TV series)|Troy]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Target]]===
Entering the outskirts of Filly, [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] passes by several Filly townspeople, two of whom she tries to introduce herself to but is coldly ignored by them. She then circumnavigates through the crowd of people and, after interacting with a [[Filly vendor]], enters the downtown area of Filly.

In the downtown area, Lucy briefly watches as the Filly townspeople assume their daily lives in the town, one of whom was pulling a [[Brahmin (TV series)|Brahmin]].
